I’ll read the handoff and project records, then continue GNP-RS-E03 and save the findings, progress, and next-model guidance in the investigation.

The proof now accounts for both Riemann–Siegel arms through the full moving cutoff. Their oscillatory cross terms vanish in the dyadic average, and the comparison back to the original fixed-time integral gives the proposed moment limit. I’ll finish checking the rational margin and record the scope of the obstruction.

The rational bounds check out. If the Jensen allowance passed at every sufficiently large center, the moment would eventually be bounded strictly below \(13/5\), which contradicts its limit \(\zeta(3/2)>13/5\). The next question is how to bound the signed logarithm at every center.

**GNP-RS-E03 r1 is complete.** At \(c=1\), the dyadic mean of the exact local quadratic moment tends to \(\zeta(3/2)\). The proof includes both Riemann–Siegel arms, all cross terms through the moving cutoff, the correction and residual, and the comparison that keeps time fixed inside each original spatial integral.

The limit forces the **exact quadratic-Jensen allowance to miss the fixed defect margin at arbitrarily high centers**, even when supplied with the exact moment. The signed Green value remains open. All 53 input identities matched on entry. The proof was checked internally, and the finite onset was left unevaluated.
